gaps.current_recoverability: URL + retrieval date + section/line locator + bounded support statement
gaps.risk: live web content may change after cutoff
gaps.closure_requirement: Create immutable/source-permitted snapshot or archived content digest before final ScientificReferenceState freeze; preserve version/date and legal retrieval constraints.

gaps.current_recoverability: primary PMID/DOI + correction PMIDs + current official summary anchors

blocking_scope: No final SRS reproducibility PASS and no R1 knowledge-ready status until relevant snapshot/correction gaps are closed.
